title: Native Contents Ownership Shared Command and SVG Paste Root Precondition
evidence: E2-L cross-version installed BEE2025/BEE2026 static disassembly
question: Does AE's native indexed child command and Path selection require a concrete Shape Layer, and does SVG paste bootstrap a new Root Vectors group?
observed_result: Generic BEE_CmdAddToIndexedStreamGroup(BEE_Layer*) has 13 direct native callers in each version and handles TDB CreateStream and Undo; native Mask and Shape path classifiers share stream tail MatchNames; native Mask vertex selection calls shared predicate; AE2026 SVG paste callback requires existing ROOT_VECTORS_GROUP and exits without conversion if missing.
limits: Static binary only; no external plugin implemented native stream child commands
A generic BEE_Layer* parameter does not imply any Effect owns its own native Contents
Pen editing and BEE_VectorArt renderer ownership unproven
